title: Assessment management
subtitle: Drafts, independent tests and version review
sandbox: Synthetic local sandbox only. These rules have no immigration validity and cannot be published in production.
name: Name
question: Question
independent: Enter expected results independently of the calculator. Passing software tests does not confirm legal accuracy.
unsaved: Unsaved changes. Save before testing or submitting.
failed: Could not complete the action. Check your input and permissions.
conflict: The version changed or this action is blocked. Your unsaved changes are retained. Check the latest version and test report.
testFailed: Some scenarios differ from their expectations
totalCap: Total score cap (blank for no additional cap)
criterionCap: Criterion cap (blank for no additional cap)
stableIdHelp: Choose a stable identity once. Changing meaning requires a new version.
usageHelp: Eligibility takes priority over score precision, then shared use and response cost. Indirect dependencies are included.
unusedQuestion: This question is currently unused by route evaluations.
removeReferencesFirst: Remove references from conditions and other questions before deleting or changing the type.
healthLimit: Up to {{count}} items needing attention are shown; totals cover all versions.
contentComparison: Content changes against the active version
noBaseline: No previously active version is available for comparison.
deviceTimezone: Time uses your device timezone. The local scheduler must be running.
incompatibleBaseline: These answers are incompatible with the previous definitions and are unknown in the baseline comparison: {{questions}}

calculator.title: Assessment interview and history
calculator.draft: Local draft. Rules have no legal approval. This development flow is not the released product.
calculator.question: Evidence group
calculator.unsaved: Unsaved changes; autosave is in progress. Retry saving if an error occurs.
calculator.failed: Operation failed. Your answer is preserved. Check the input and connection, then retry.
calculator.conflict: The session changed. Your answer is preserved. Reload the revision, then review your answer.
calculator.nominationCondition: Hypothetical scenario: conditional on confirmed provincial or territorial nomination. These points are not added to the current result.
calculator.stale: This result differs from current data or rules. Record a fresh result for the current position.
calculator.selfReported: Based on recorded, unverified answers. Points do not guarantee pool entry, an invitation or a visa.
calculator.provenance: Answer source: {{source}}; document verification is separate.
calculator.halfOpenDates: End is the first day outside the employment period. Overlapping periods are counted once.
calculator.factsReviewOnly: This review concerns recorded evidence. It cannot approve legal rules or publication. The author cannot review their own result.
calculator.reviewFailed: Review was not recorded. Check permissions, reviewer independence and freshness.
calculator.unverified: This is self-reported evidence. The reviewer must independently check its source and documents.
calculator.offline: You are offline. Your answer is preserved and the same request will resume when connected.
calculator.noEmployment: I have no employment history to declare

profile.title: Information already in your account
profile.explanation: These records are suggestions. Review and confirm them before calculation. Your profile is not changed. Upload approval does not verify migration facts.
profile.conflict: This differs from another record or your saved answer. Choose the correct information explicitly.
profile.incomplete: These work dates need confirmation, including the end-date boundary. Add hours, country and qualifying facts before saving.
profile.confirmation: Check every value below, complete missing facts and confirm. This replaces the current answer group; it does not verify the document.

reasons.education_equivalence_required: An earned qualification is recorded. Country, recognition and Canadian equivalence must be supplied separately; the title is not awarded points automatically.
reasons.four_skills_and_test_variant_required: An overall score cannot replace four skill scores. Enter the exact test variant, date and each skill in the language form.
reasons.structured_facts_required: The file has no structured calculator facts. Review its contents and enter the relevant facts manually.
reasons.invalid_stored_numeric_evidence: The stored score is invalid. Correct and confirm it before use.

profile.reloadConflict: Account information or the session changed. Your draft is kept. Discard it and refresh account information to choose again.

guided.title: Guided interview
guided.intro: Choose the country in the form, then start. Questions follow missing evidence in the draft assessment; unknown answers are kept without repeated prompts. You can also edit groups manually.
guided.mode: Purpose of the next interview round
guided.scenario: Continue exploring a scenario despite unmet conditions
guided.stop: Pause questions for the current result
guided.incomplete: This answer is still missing facts that affect the result. Complete them or explicitly choose unknown.
guided.sourceChanged: The source for this answer changed. Review it before continuing.
guided.deferred: {{count}} answer(s) remain unresolved. They will not be asked again automatically.
guided.policyRow: {{field}} · priority {{tier}}, answer cost {{cost}}, unresolved effects {{effects}}, shared uses {{shared}}
guided.failed: The interview context or pinned version is unavailable. Answers are kept. Refresh; if the old version remains unavailable, start a new session and keep this history.

tiers.0: Source information must be checked again.
tiers.1: This choice determines which assessment can be used.
tiers.2: This answer affects a covered entry requirement.
tiers.3: This answer may resolve a points threshold.
tiers.4: This answer affects an unresolved score component.

statuses.question: A relevant question is available.
statuses.user_requested_result: Questions are paused at your request. You can record the current draft result below.
statuses.covered_routes_blocked: A known condition blocks the covered route(s). This does not reject unsupported routes. Choose scenario mode to explore remaining facts.
statuses.incomplete_needs_review: No further question can currently resolve the gaps. Some facts are unknown, blocked or need specialist review; the result remains partial.
statuses.initial_result_available: The supplied facts resolve this initial draft assessment. You can record the result below. This is not legal approval.
statuses.session_complete: This session is complete. Its recorded history remains available.

guided.skip: I do not know; defer this question
guided.definitionChanged: The definition of this group changed. Review your earlier answer using the new definition.
guided.ranking: Order: requirement priority, number of unresolved effects, shared uses, answer cost, then fixed field order. Costs are relative effort units, not points or time estimates.

exclusionReasons.alternative_stream_met: An alternative support stream already meets this check
exclusionReasons.language_report_supplied: A language report is already supplied
exclusionReasons.language_absent: The applicant explicitly has no report

guided.routeRequired: Choose an Australian subclass before calculation or recording. Your answers remain saved; no route is assumed.
guided.routeRequiredPaused: Questions are paused. Choose an Australian subclass before calculation or recording; your answers remain saved.

comparison.title: Compare routes and next actions
comparison.open: Open route comparison and action plan
comparison.scope: Draft comparison. Canadian and Australian scores use different scales and are not ranked together. Covered initial conditions do not establish visa or document approval.
comparison.hypothetical: Hypothetical score only if the condition above is fulfilled: {{score}}
comparison.unavailable: Validated costs, timelines and historical evidence are unavailable for this comparison; financial fit and success probability remain undetermined.
comparison.progressMeaning: Marking an action done only reports your progress. It does not verify an answer, document or legal condition. Remaining gaps still require reassessment.
comparison.failed: Could not load or save the comparison. Saved information is preserved.
comparison.conflict: Answers, sources or versions changed. Refresh before continuing. Recorded history is preserved.
comparison.discardRequest: Discard pending request and reload its status
comparison.orderMeaning: Choose routes to compare. Display order follows your selections and is not a suitability ranking. Remove and reselect a route to move it to the end.
comparison.recheck: You reported completion; this gap remains in the assessment and needs reassessment.

labels.requires_route_evidence: Evidence for this specific subclass required
labels.confirmed_nomination: Hypothetical condition: obtain a valid confirmed nomination
labels.invitation_and_qualifying_support: Hypothetical condition: invitation and qualifying support for this subclass
labels.fst_not_implemented: Federal Skilled Trades calculation is not implemented
labels.subclass_specific_evidence_required: Invitation, occupation and partner evidence are not transferred from another subclass
labels.ordinary_cec_only: Ordinary CEC only; self-employed physician exception not covered
labels.fsw_covered_requirements_only: Only implemented FSW conditions were checked
labels.select_route_evidence: Select subclass and supply its specific evidence
labels.review_unmet_requirement: Review unmet condition and whether the route can proceed
labels.independent_evidence_review: Request independent review of evidence and limitations
labels.canadian_year_last_three: Canadian year within the last three years
labels.language_qualified_canadian_year: Canadian work with required language level
